Priya: Heads-up — Marcus submitted resignation this morning. Last day is 2026-04-20. Can we assemble the offboard checklist (device return, deploy keys, slack admin removal, exit interview)?

Marcus: Confirmed. I'll do KT and leave notes for the SRE rotation. Happy to help with handoff.

Elena (IT): Created ticket HR-10021 for asset pickup + badge deactivation. Options: UPS pickup or drop at HQ. We'll also set badge to expire on 2026-04-20 23:59 PT. For admins, example deprovision steps:
```
# deactivate Okta
okta-cli suspend-user marcus.k@redwood.ai
# disable Slack access (SCIM)
scim-client delete /Users/marcus.k@redwood.ai
# remove access badge
badgectl revoke --user marcus.k --effective 2026-04-20
```

Kelsey: Benefits reminder — company policy: medical through the end of the termination month. With last day 4/20, coverage ends 2026-04-30. COBRA packet from ADP emailed within 14 days. I'll DM Marcus the link and confirm final paycheck timing and PTO payout.

Sam: CI/CD and infra handoff: Marcus currently holds deploy keys for the following:
- GitLab CI deploy key (project: infra/helm-charts)
- AWS account cross-account deploy role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/deploy-redwood)
- GKE service account used by canary deployer
Please create replacement keys/roles or rotate and update any automation.

Arun: I'll rotate the GitLab deploy key and create a new cross-account role for Arjun to assume. Marcus, can you post the list of all pipelines that rely on your keys? Also please mark any cron jobs in kubernetes that need ownership transfer.

Marcus: Short list (most used ones): infra/helm-charts (release job), infra/cluster-tools (kubecron backups), webapp/canary (canary deploy). I'll add a full inventory to the offboard ticket by EOD Tue.

Elena (IT): Quick ask about third-party admin accounts (send in table format: service | admin user | recommended replacement). We rotate creds for shared logins and remove invites.

Marcus: Short table here:
- PagerDuty | marcus@redwood.ai | Arjun
- NewRelic | marcus@newrelic.com | Mei
- CircleCI org admin | marcus@redwood.ai | DevOps Team
I'll DM more sensitive entries.

Sam: For the deploy rotation: I'll schedule a 45m KT session with Marcus + Arjun + Mei on Wed 9am PT and a 30m follow-up Thu. Marcus, please include runbooks and any short screencasts.

Kelsey: Payroll note — final paycheck incl. accrued PTO will be processed on the next payroll run after termination. I'll confirm exact deposit date in HR ticket HR-10021. Also will send the ADP COBRA packet as soon as we receive it.

Priya: Action summary — please update HR-10021 when done:
- @Elena (IT): asset pickup, badge expire, Slack/Okta suspend
- @Arun: rotate deploy keys & create new role for Arjun
- @Sam: schedule KT sessions + collect runbooks
- @Kelsey: COBRA packet + final pay/PTO confirm
- @Marcus: upload inventory, screencasts, and list of third-party admins

peopleops-bot: Exit interview invite drafted and sent to Marcus + Priya — proposed 2026-04-16 11:00 AM PT. RSVP pending. Exit survey link: https://redwood.hr/exit-survey/1978000000

Marcus: 4/16 11am works for me. I'll fill the survey after the KT sessions.

Arun: One more infra note — shift on-call entries that list Marcus as primary owner. Use oncallctl to reassign: `oncallctl transfer --from marcus.k --to arjun.g --services infra-monitoring,backup-jobs`. I'll run this after the KT.

Elena (IT): Reminder for managers: if Marcus has any company-paid subscriptions or hardware vendor accounts in his name, list those in the ticket so we can cancel or transfer billing.

Marcus: I'll add billing items and the full pipeline inventory to HR-10021 by EOD Tue. Thanks everyone for the quick responses.

Priya: Thanks team — I'll close when HR-10021 shows all items completed. :thumbsup:
